ModMetadata.Name: Salty's Advanced Airlock
ModMetadata.Author: Joshua
ModMetadata.Description: A fail-safe layer for the vanilla Advanced Airlock Control: power-tier staging from a Station Battery (Normal / Low / Critical), a guaranteed escape path when power is critical, propped-open handling with real atmosphere-safety thresholds, and target-driven vent relief. Works under StationeersLaunchPad or as a plain BepInEx plugin.
